description: Today’s global cyber threat condition (Clear, Cloudy, Showers, Storm or Severe) from BitScore’s Cyber Weather, refreshed daily at 07:30 IST: points per instrument, CISA KEV additions, EPSS risers, outlook, patch calendar, outages and three actions. Each field names its source and licence. Indicative, not a measure of any organisation’s risk.
name: cyber_weather_today
title: Cyber Weather today
